connector.name: Gmail by pulsemcp.com
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Gmail with OAuth2 (personal) and service account (Workspace) support.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gmail-workspace-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.pulsemcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GMAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
env.description: OAuth2 client ID from Google Cloud Console (for personal Gmail accounts).

env.name: GMAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: OAuth2 client secret from Google Cloud Console.

env.name: GMAIL_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN
env.description: Refresh token from the OAuth2 setup script.

env.name: GMAIL_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CLIENT_EMAIL
env.description: Service account email address (for Google Workspace).

env.name: GMAIL_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Service account private key in PEM format (for Google Workspace).

env.name: GMAIL_IMPERSONATE_EMAIL
env.description: Email address to impersonate (required for service account mode).

env.name: GMAIL_ENABLED_TOOLGROUPS
env.description: Comma-separated list of tool groups to enable (readonly, readwrite, readwrite_external).
